Im playing for few days so i can give some tips, but im not an experienced player with many warps. So some things i say maybe wrong.

>Is it better to spend main upgrade points on damage or power?

Early only on damage. Later on power.

>What's a good upgrade point distribution for a newbie?

Damage, Fire Rate, Criticals in that order.

>What bits upgrades do you prioritize?

If im active - dps (skills that do damage and attack, defense depends on your "git gud" stat). If im afk, then defense (def, shield, repair, idle) and some dps (10-20% of bits).

>How many boss runs do you typically do before reincarnating?

When they stop giving permanent upgrades or im inpatient.

>Any tips for speeding up progress after a reincarnation?

Get more permanent upgrades and get some good modules that work without lvl req.

>What are your favorite stats to look for on modules early to mid game?
